versions.content:
[SWS_CM_00057] Mapping of Offer Service in case of
Signal-Based IEEE1722
ACF
network binding
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00006, RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204
⌈
If instructed to
offer
a service instance which is mapped to a
ProvidedUserDe-
finedServiceInstance
of
category SIGNALBASED_IEEE1722_ACF
, then the
Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF
network binding shall create / use a socket for the
communication on the
EthernetCommunicationConnector
that the
Provide-
dUserDefinedServiceInstance
is mapped to via the
UserDefinedServiceIn-
stanceToMachineMapping
.
communicationConnector
. If a socket with identical
credentials already exists, then this existing socket shall be used.
⌋
